announcement.title: 0.4.18-b2 released — localization, training mode, reliability
announcement.message: 0.4.18-b2 is out. The entire desktop client is now translated and ships complete English and Russian (with a native-name language dropdown and localized text-to-speech callouts); community translations still drop into the lang/ folder with no rebuild. New moderator Training mode (Settings -> Training) lets a trainer fire simulated events through the real pipeline — including a genuine Discord post to practice tagging — all marked [TRAINING] and isolated from live moderation, with an optional /set-training-channel to keep drills out of the real audit log. Reliability watchdogs now make Scarlet's silent failure modes loud and recoverable: it detects a stalled log tailer or an expired VRChat session, attempts unattended re-login, and can route health alerts to a staff channel via /set-ops-alert-channel. Data files also now save crash-safely with dated backups. See the changelog for the full list.
